Teacher booked for removing student's tilak; CM vows action

An FIR has been registered against a teacher in West Bengal for allegedly removing a student's tilak. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari stated that such incidents will not be tolerated in Bengal and that the teacher has been removed from their post. The incident has drawn attention from various media outlets.
